༄༅/ /shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i skong gso'i cho ga ro langs thal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i skong gso'i cho ga ro langs

thal byed ces bya ba bzhugs/ hūm̐/ 'grub par gyur cig tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i gtso/ /rang byung pad+ma rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed chen mo rab tu dgyes bya'i phyir/ /skong gso'i rim pa ji ltar bya ba bshad/ /de la ma mo'i dpal gtor mtheb skyus bskor ba sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan pa bshams la/ tshogs dang spyan gzigs dang nya bo la sogs pa dgos pa rnams bsags te/ rang nyid pad+ma'i nga rgyal gyis mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas//sprul pa'i me ri mtshon cha 'bar/ khro bo'i sprul pas nam mkhas khengs//phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug /rlung yang rgyu ba'i skabs med na/ /bar chad bgegs rnams smos ci dgos/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra yis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun gang bar gyur/ /me ri mtshon cha'i ra ba'i gur/ /rdo rje'i ra ba chen po las/ /su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa ya pa gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūṃ/ a na ya ho bha ga wānra bid+ya rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed la/ spyan drangs ba ni/ oṃ khyi kha ye nag mo trag rak+ṣa sa ma ye dza dzaḥ ma ma trag rak+ṣa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mo ni/ /sha za khrag 'thung dpal gyi yum chen rnams/ /ru lu'i sgra skad nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /lho sprin 'thibs tshul sku mdog nag mor ston/ /glog ltar 'khyugs shing gang la'ang thogs pa med/ /dus bzhir nyul byed bstan pa'i dam rdzas bsrung*/ /thugs kyi ma mo srog sgrub nag mo ni/ /nam gru zhing gi rdul snyed 'khor dang bcas/ /gdung bas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bka' dang bstan pa srungs la gang zag skyongs/ /'dod pa'i don skongs phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/

/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya gh+ri ga dzaḥ/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /kun tu bzang mo'i sprul pa las/ /srid pa'i ma mo yal gam can/ /shan pa srog sgrub nag mo ste/ /ral pa g.yengs pas nam mkha' khyab/ /ral pa re la phur pa re/ /phur bu 'khrol bas stong khams g.yo/ /chibs su rlung nag 'tshubs ma bcibs/ /phyag g.yas snying rtsa dmar po bsnams/ /g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa ste/ /gcer bu mi lpags stod la dkris/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad/ /shangs nas rlu 'tshubs bu yug 'gyed/ /ba spu me stag mtshon cha 'phro/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ /gsod byed ma mo gshegs su gsol/ /g.yas na gsod byed sha za ma/ /dmar mo sha za lce spyang gdong*/ / ro la zhon nas sha la za/ /g.yas g.yon zhing dbyug ti ra bsnams/ /sha za chen mo gshegs su gsol/ /g.yon na nag mo wa gdong ma/ /phyag na gri gug zhags pa bsnams/ /dur bya zhon nas mkha' la rgyu/ /las mkhan chen mo gshegs su gsol/ /mdun na srog gcod sha za stong*/ /nag mo 'ug gdong gnam lcags sder/ khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra/ /dur phag 'phar ba rkang rdeb dang*/ /stag spyang dom dred la sogs zhon/ /skad cig stong gsum nyul byed ma/ /sha za nag mo gshegs= /rgyab na las byed ma mo 'bul/ /sku mdog sna tshogs 'jigs pa la/ /nad dang mtshon gyi gru gu rkyongs/ /thog dang ser chen glog dmar 'gyed/ /drel rta zhon nas phyogs bcur rgyug /las kyi ma mo gshegs= /gsod byed kun gyi bka' nyan mo/ /bye ba 'bum phrag mang po rnams/ /la las nad kyi bu yug gtong*/ /la las mtshon gyi bskal pa gtong*/ /la las dus kyi 'khrug pa gtong*/ /la las mi nad phyugs nad gtong*/ /la las zhing chen rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /la las zhing chung glad la bskor/ /la las ti ra phyogs bcur 'phen/ /la las dul mo sa la rdeb/ /de la sogs te bsam mi khyab/ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa rnams/

/skad cig yud kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ khyi kha le rak+mo rak+mo ru ru pheṃ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas thibs kyis byon par bsam pa kun dam tshig pa la brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa/ /dpal ldan srog sgrub 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ru ru sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ ces pas bzhugs par bsams la/ dang po brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings kyi yum chen thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /'dod rgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /shan pa srog sgrub 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sgrub mchog bdag gis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / oṃ gyi kha le pra tīts+tsha hoḥdam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan srog sgrub nam gru 'khor bcas rnams/ /dam bca' bdag dang mi 'bral rtag tu brten/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag la byin rlobs dkyil 'khor gnyan por bzung*/ /oṃ khyi kha le badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ sman raka dang mchod gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dgra'i sha khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor bsams la/ rim par 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bsad khrag rak+ta'i rba klong 'khyil/ /keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa ste/ /sha chen dmar gyi gtor ma 'di/ /ma tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ khyi kha le nag mo ma trag rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā māṃ sa ya khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la= ma hā tsit+ta la = ma hā ba du ta la = ma hā go ro tsa na la= ma hā a mṛ ta la khā hi/ hūm̐/ sna tshogs bdud rtsi mchog gi ro/ /rtsa ba brgyad la yal ga stong*/ /srog sgrub 'khor dang bcas pa mchod/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpal chen ma tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /tshogs dang gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis/

/bzhes nas las kyi dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ /thugs dam gnyan bskang bcol pa'i las mdzod cig /hūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi mchod pa dang*/ /tshogs dang gtor ma sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ /sha lnga la sogs mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyis/ /ma dngamakha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig /oṃ mahā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ skong bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan srog sgrub 'khor bcas la/ /spos dang mar mes thugs dam bskang*/ /me tog dri chab= sil snyan rol mos= /bskangs pas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / dpal gyi ma tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /dmar chen gtor mas thugs dam= zhun chen rak+tas= /tshil chen dud pas= /rkang gling rol mos= /bskangs pas dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dpal gyi ma tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /bsad khrag rba klong thugs= /dbang po rnam lngas= /sha sna snying snas= /dza gad phud kyis= /spyan gzigs mang pos= /bskangs pas dngos grub bdag la stsol/ / hūm̐/ skye med nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin las/ /ma rig 'khrul pas nga dang bdag tu bzung*/ /kun rtog nyon mongs gzung 'dzin gdon gyis brlams/ / chos nyid don dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /thugs rje'i dbyings las sprul pa'i ma mo khyod/ /sku gsung thugs su bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*/ / bdag rtog dri mas de ltar rngo ma thogs/ /bsnyen sgrub don las nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /dpal ldan nag mo 'khor bcas spyan snga ru/ /rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa chen po dang*/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma la sogs te/ / tshogs kyi mchod pa mngon du ma bshams pa/ /mchod dang sgrub rdzas nyams pa= /bdag ni mi shes nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa'i las rnams bgyis/ /bgyid dang bgyid du stsal ba ci mchis pa/ / 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa thams cad bshags/ /ting 'dzin ma gsal bsnyen sgrub don las g.yel/ /sgom pa yun thung bzlas grangs nyung ba dang*/

cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nor ba dang*/ /mchod gtor nyams dang dus las yol ba dang*/ /chag nyams las kyi skyon rnams thams cad kyang*/ /rang gnod 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol= /dam rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa yun thung dang*/ /ting 'dzin ma gsal bsnyen sgrub 'chol bar spyad/ /sbyor dang sgrol ba'i las mtha' log pa dang*/ /thun dang zor gyi las rnams ma rdzogs pas/ /srog sgrub 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs dang 'gal/ /tshor dang ma tshor nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /mthol zhing bshags so tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni mi shes dang po las can te/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag zhig ral ci mchis pa/ /byams ldan thugs rje'i yum la bshags par bgyi// bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pa brjod do/ /de nas mnga' gsol ba ni/ phud dang rak+ta sbreng*/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hoḥ/ dpal ldan sngags kyi bdag mo srung ma chen po sku mdog nag mo zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ khrag dang zhag gi thig le byugs shing ral pa g.yengs pas nam mkha' khengs pa/ phyag na snying dang nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams pa/ zhal nas rak+ta'i zham chu 'bab cing mche ba rno dkar dgra la gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum bskal pa'i me 'od 'bar zhing me'i tshwa tshwa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i nang na bzhugs shing nad dang mtshon gyi bskal ba gtong ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i spu gseb nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas stong khams thams cad khengs par byed pa khyed la/ dmar gyi gtor ma brjid cing 'gying ba/ ri rab lhun po bas 'phangs mtho ba/ rak+ta'i zham chu bas bskyil legs pa/ rgya mtsho chen pos bas gting zab pa/ dkar la dmar gyi thig bkyes pa nyi zla gza' skar bas mdangs gsal ba/ dpal gyi mtheb skyus mtha' bskor ba gling bzhi gling phran bas bkod legs pa/ dar dang za 'og gi gur phub pa/ mthing ga brjid chags pa/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis mdun bshams pa lha'i 'byor ba bas rgya che ba 'di 'bul lo/

/ gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /bsam pa gnyan po sgrubs shig /re ba gnyan po skongs shig /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad skongs shig /sdang ba dgra sod cig /gnod pa'i bgegs thul zhig /tshe dpal dang 'byor pa spel zhig /snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs shig /gzhan yang dpal ldan nag mo thugs kyi dbyes sde mo/ g.yas kyi gsod byed sha za dmar mo/ g.yas g.yon zhing dbyug dang rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ ro la zhon nas phyogs bcur rgyug pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /bsam pa gnyan po sgrubs shig /re ba gnyan po skongs shig /'gal 'khrul dang nyams chag thams cad skongs shig sdang ba'i dgra sod cig /gnod pa'i bgegs thul zhig /tshe dpal dang 'byor pa spel zhig /snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs shig / g.yon na nag mo wa gdong ma/ phyag na gri gug dang rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ dur bya zhon nas mkha' la rgyu ba la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ mchod do/ / bsam pa gnyan po= /re ba gnyan po= /'gal 'khrul= /sdang ba'i= / gnod pa'i= /tshe dpal= /snyan pa dang = /mdun na srog gco kyi sha za nag mo stong/ 'ug pa khwa dang bya rgod la sogs pa'i gdong dang ldan pa/ khrag gi ral pas gnam sa khyab cing mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams pa/ stag spyang dom dred 'phar ba zhon cing skad cig stong gsum kun tu nyul ba'i tshogs la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /bsam pa= /re ba= /'gal 'khrul= / sdang ba'i= /gnod pa'i= /tshe dpal= /snyan pa dang = /rgyab na las kyi ma mo 'bum phrag sku mdog sna tshogs 'jigs par ston pa/ phyag na nad dang mtshon cha bsnams pa/ thog dang ser chen glog dmar 'gyu ba/ chibs su drel rta rkang gsum bcibs pa/ gsod byed 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do= /bsam pa= /re ba= /'gal= /sdang = gnod= /tshe dpal= /snyan pa dang*/ pho nya yang sprul bka' nyan gyi tshogs su gyur pa 'bum phrag bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ la las gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/

la las sil snyan rol mo 'khrol ba/ la las nad kyi rkyal ba thogs pa/ la las mtshon gyi gru gu rkyong pa/ la las thog dang ser ba 'bebs pa/ la las glo bur ye 'drog gtong ba/ la las ltas ngan cho 'phrul 'gyed pa/ la la rlung nag 'tshubs mar 'khyil ba/ la las mi rkang gling bu 'bud pa/ la las 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa/ la las dul mo sa la brdul ba/ la las sprul pa 'bum phrag 'gyed pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsol lo/ /'bul lo= /mchod do= /bsam pa gnyan= /re ba gnyan= /'gal 'khrul= /sdang ba'i dgra la= gnod pa'i bgegs/ chag che dang nyam nga thams cad zlog cig /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul chen po sgrubs shig /tshe dpal dang 'byor pa chen po spel zhig /snyan pa dang grags pa bzang po sgrogs shig /ces brjod do/ /de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du/ yul gyi ma mo thams cad 'dus pa'i tshe/ /thugs kyi ma mo gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ shan pa srog sgrub nag mor mnga' gsol ba/ /sku mdog nag mo lho sprin 'thibs pa 'dra/ /ral pa g.yengs pas nam mkha' thams cad chod/ /phur bu 'khrol bas stong khams thams cad g.yo/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag rno dkar mche ba gtsigs/ /shangs nas rlung 'tshubs spyan gsum sdang mig gzigs// zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku yi stod du dkris/ /ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i nang du sku bzhugs pa/ /shan pa srog sgrub sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yas na gsod byed sha za ral pa can/ /sku mdog dmar mo zhing dbyug rgyu zhags 'dzin/ /gcer bu ro zhon stong khams khyab par nyul/ /las byed nag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon na 'jigs byed nag mo wa gdong ma/ /gri gug rgyu zhags sdang ba'i dgra la 'debs/ / dur bya zhon nas stong khams khyab par nyul/ /las byed nag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdunu na srog gcong sha za nag mo stong*/ khwa dang 'ug pa bya rgod gdong can sogs/

khrag gi ral ba gnam sa kun tu khyab/ /mda' chen mdung dang 'khor lo gtun shing sogs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs dgra bgegs steng du 'phen/ /stag spyang dom dred ma he gzig la sogs/ /sna tshogs zhon nas stong khams kun tu nyul/ /sha za stong gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rgyab na sna tshogs las kyi ma mo 'bum/ /sna tshogs sku mdog gar yang sprul zhing bsgyur/ /mi bzod mtshon dang thog chen skar mda' 'phen/ /drel rta zhon nas stong khams khyab par nyul/ /las byed ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun gyi bka' nyan pho nya yang sprul ni/ /'bum phrag bsam yas sna tshogs 'jigs gzugs can/ /ru lu'i sgra skad nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /la la gdugs dang bla re rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /la la 'phan lding sil snyan rol mo 'dzin/ /la la gar byed rin chen char ba 'bebs/ /la la rdo rje nor bu pad+ma 'dzin/ /la la rgyas mdzad ri chen sgrom bu 'dzin/ /la la dbang mdzad chags tshul mdangs dang ldan/ /la la drag mdzad 'jigs gzugs rngams pa ste/ /la la zil gnon drag po'i phrin las mdzad/ /la la nad kyi rkyal pa dgra la gtong*/ /la la mtshon gyi bskal pa dgra la gtong*/ / la la ltas ngan glo bur ye 'drog gtong*/ /la la mi rkang gling bu dgra la 'bud/ /la la rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i nang na bzhugs/ /la la 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa ste/ /la la dug chen sa la brdal bar byed/ /pho nya yang sprul tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod nas/ phud dang rak+ta gtor mar sbran la/ thugs dam gnad nas bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ shan pa nag mo mi zan ma/ /ming po rdo rjai bdag 'bod kyis/ /sring mo ma thogs myur du sbyon/ /ming po rdo rje'i las mdzod cig /ma g.yel ma g.yel ma dang sring*/ /brag phug gnyan por 'du ba dang*/ /ma dang sring mo nye ru re/ /shan pa nag mo nye ru re/ / māṃ sa zas su za ba yang*/

/ma dang sring mo= /shan pa nag mo/ /tshil chen dud pa gtong ba yang*/ /mdangs= /shan pa= bhan+bha rak+tas bkang ba yang*/ mdang = shan pa= / dmar chen gtor mas mchod pa yang*/ /mdangs= /shan pa= /dza gad phud kyis mchod pa yang*/ mdang = /shan pa= /zhing chen g.yab mo bya ba yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /mi rkang glingabu 'bud pa yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /tshogs dang mchod pas bskang ba yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod pa yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom pa yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /srog gi snying po bzla ba yang*/ / mdangs= /shan pa= thun dang zor gyis bskang ba yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /shel nag mun pas bskang ba yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /mkha' lding nag mos bskang ba yang*/ mdangs= /shan pa= /nam gru nag mo 'khor bcas la/ dmar chen gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ dza gad phud kyis

= zhun chen mar mes = tshil chen dud pas = sman dang rak+tas = shel nag 'ba' lding = rnga dang rol mos = thun dang zor gyis = bskang ngo bskal bar = bskangs pas dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ /dge zhing zhi ba'i las 'grub dang*/ /'dod pa skongs la bsam pa sgrubs/ /chag che nyam nga la sogs pa'i/ /rkyen ngan bar chad zlog pa dang*/ /dgra sod bgegs thul 'dod pa sgrubs/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta la/ ma hā go ro tsa na la/ ma hā a mṛ ta la khā haṃ/ zhes phud dang rak+ta sbreng ngo*/ /rgyun gyi skong gsol de nas gtor ma btang nas bkra shis brjod/ gal te mngon spyod kyi las bsgrub dgos na/ gdab las dang rbad bskul bya ba las/ gdab las ni nya bo'i steng du lag phur ram zangs gri la sogs pas gdab cing dgra dngos su bsams la/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i ma mo mthu mo che/ / bshan pa gsod byed nag mo ste/ /zhabs gnyis rak+ta'i rba la 'phyo/ /phyag gnyis phur bus dgra snying gzir/ /srog dbugs lhu gzugs so sor 'bral/ /dam nyams dgra bo che ge yi/ /srog chod snying phyung dbang po snubs/ /dus mtha' bltungs la gzer chen phob/ /de yi bka' nyan las mkhan mo/ /lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /dgra bo'i steng du da gzir cig /mgo lus phrol la don snying phyungs/ /sha zo khrag 'thung rus la ya/ /shan pa nag mo'i zhal du bstab/ /las mkhan 'bum gyi zhal du=/ /sha za stong gi= /gdugapa'i dgra bo che ge mo/ /shan pa 'khor bcas = ma dang sring mo'i = sha rus kham tshad lings si ling*/ /snying khrag dron mo tsa ra ra/ /glo snying nang khrol chi li li/ /zhing chen lhu gzugs khro lo lo/ /thod rus rdzul tshigs nyi li li/ /ma sring zhal du kha raṃ khā hi/ /oṃ khyi kha le nag mo li li ti ti ram̐ ram̐ bh+yo bh+yo/ ma ma rak+mo rak+mo che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum kha kha khā hi khā

hi/ /zhes pas dum bur bral gtor mar bstab bo/ /de nas las kyi mo dgra la rbad pa ni/ gtor ma dgra phyogs su btegs rab tu khros bas 'di skad do/ /bh+yo/ mkha' 'gro nag mo mi srun ma/ /sha za khrag mig srin mo'i gdong*/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /sku mdog nag mo char sprin mdog /phyag na gsod pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /chibs su srid pa'i rlung la bcibs/ /ral pa mtshon cha sha ra ra/ /gcer bu mi lpags stod la dkris/ /glo snying khrag 'dzag zhal du gsol/ khrag gi zham chu kyu ru ru/ /mche ba zangs yag rab tu gtsigs/ /sma ra ser po me stag 'phro/ /spyan gsum sdang mig dgra la gzigs/ /shangs nas 'tshubs ma mtshon char 'gyed/ /ba spu mtshon cha me ltar 'bar/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ / dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bo'i steng du+u da rgyug cig /dam nyams snying la da gzir cig / dbugs chod srog 'phrog bdud chod cig / g.yas na gsod byed sha za ma/ / sku mdog dmar mo tso re re/ /ral pa nyil bab sa gzhi khebs/ /phur bu 'khril bas stong gsum g.yo/ /ro la zhon nas sha la za/ /rkan brdab dgra bo'i mig 'bras 'brul/ /lcags sder mtshon chas dgra snying 'byin/ /zhing dbyug rdebs pas srid gsum g.yo/ /dung gi mche ba thams se tham/ /khrag gi mchi ma chi li li/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bo'i steng du da rgyug cig /dam nyams snying la da gzir cig /srog rtsa dmar po da chod cig /g.yon na nag mo wa yi gdong*/ /sku mdog nag mo tso re re/ /zhal nas khrag gi zham chu 'bab/ /phyag na zhags pa gri gug thogs/ /ba spu mtshon cha spu gri'i so/ /reg pa tsam gyis mgo lus 'bral/ / dur bya zhon nas stong khams nyul/ /dmar chen = dgra bo' = /dam nyams = srog rtsa chod la snying rtsa phyung*/ /sha zo khrag 'thung keng rus mur/ /mdun na srog gcod sha za stong*/ /sku mdog mthing nag tse re re/

khra dang 'ug pa bya rgod gdong*/ khrag ral mtshon cha nyi li li/ /bse yi 'dab gshog spu gri 'bar/ /gnam lcags mchu sder zangs se zang*/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs sha ra ra/ /lce spyang zhon nas stong khams nyul/ /dmar chen/ dgra bo'i/ srog rtsa/ sha zo khrag 'thung rus la mur/ /rgyab na las byed ma mo 'bum/ /sku mdog sna tshogs co re re/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug /drel rta zhon nas stong khams nyul/ /ral pa mtshon cha nyi li li/ /dmar chen= dgra bo'i = dam nyams = srog rtsa = sha zo = /bka' nyan yang sprul pho nya mo/ /las mkhan 'bum phrag bye ba rnams/ / 'jigs pa'i gzugs can sna tshogs te/ / la la byad kha rbod gtong mo/ / gcer bu gri thogs ye re re/ /la la nad dang rims bdag mo/ /nad yams bu yug thu lu lu/ /la la glo bur ye 'drog mo/ / gri rgod 'khrug pa sha ra ra/ /la la rmugs byed ro langs mo/ /smyo 'bog brgyal nad tha la la/ /la la phung byed sgrol ging mo/ /bsad khrag rba klong nye re re/ /la la 'joms byed las mkhan mo/ /dgra bgegs rdul du sangs se sang*/ /la la gsod byed shan pa mo/ /snying khrag zhal du kyu ru ru/ /la la 'bod byed ro langs mo/ / 'o dod gnam du lhangs se lhang*/ /la la dul byed las mkhan mo/ /zhing che g.yab mo lings se ling*/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bo steng du da rgyug cig /dam nyams snying la da gzir cig /srog rtsa chod la snying rtsa phung*/ sha zo khrag 'thung rus la mur/ / gsod byed chen mo da rgyug cig /lus srog phrol la dbang po snubs/ /las mkhan chen mo dang*/ /dbugs longs bdud chod 'od phrogs shig /sgrol ging chen mo da/ sha zo khrag 'thur rus la mur/ byed mkhan chen mo da= /dgra bo'i snying la thun zor bh+yo/ nad bdag chen mo/ /dgra la dal yams gzer thung phab/ /rims bdag chen mo da/ dgra la yams nad khrag nad phob/ /smyo byed chen mo da/ /dgra la brgyal nad smyo 'bog thong*/

/rjed byed chen mod/ dgra rnams rmugs shi rengs su chug / 'jigs byed chen mo da/ /dgra rnams thal ba'i rdul du rlog /za byed chen mo da/ dgra rnams snying khrag gting nas 'jab/ gnod byed chen mo da/ dgra rnams tshal pa dum bur gtubs/ / 'joms byed chen mo da/ /dgra rnams thams cad da gzhom cig /sna stun chen mo da/ /dgra rnams mi mthun so sor phyes/ phung byed chen mo da/ /dgra rnams ming tsam med par mdzod/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog /me yis sregs la chu yis shol/ /rlung gis gtor la stong par mdzod/ /oṃ khyi kha le nag mos sod/ /srog tri sod/ /snying kha kha bam ya sod/ tsa ba b.ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ rak+mo rak+mo ma gzir nan/ khaṃ khug drongs che ge mo'i tsit+ta la rbad/ ces brjod do/ /de nas rang nyid drag po'i lhar gsal zhing shin tu rngams pas thun dang zor gyi las bya ste/ zor lam dbye ba dang*/ /dpang gzug pa dang*/ nyes pa bsgrag pa ni/ bh+yoḥ ma sring dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /lha klu sde brgyad la sogs pa/ /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang*/ /yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /do nub gzu dang dpang mdzod cig /dam nyams sdig can dgra bo 'dis/ /rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag /byang chub bsgrub tu ma ster bas/ /thun dang zor gyi las byos shig /bdag la sdang byed dgra bo'i 'dis/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku+u la bsdos/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bshig /dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po smad/ /'jig rten skye bo yongs la 'tshe/ / dben gnas gnyan 'di bcom brlag byas/ /rdo rje rgyal por dmangs su phab/ /srung ma gnyan po khyed du bsad/ /sdig can las kyi mtha' 'khor bas/ /do nub bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /bh+yo/ sngags 'chang bdag gis zor cig 'phen/ /do nub zor gyi lam phyis shing*/ /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no/ /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no/ /gzhi bdag gnyan la mi 'phen

no/ /dbu zhabs bsrings pa thams cad sdus/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du 'phen/ /shan pa 'khor bcas da rgyug cig /ma sring las mkha' chen mo rnams/ /thun dang zor gyi las la bh+yo/ hūm̐/ nyungs dkar thun gyi rgyal po 'di/ /yan lag med par stong gsum 'gro /gshog pa med par nam mkhar lding*/ /mtshon cha med par lto rgyab 'byin/ /dgra bo dam nyams che ge mo/ /lto rgyab gtsang mar thal gyis phyungs/ /thogs pa med par bsgral du gsol/ /oṃ khyi kha len nag mos sod/ /mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ rbad thum ri li li he ba he sa ra kha ra ho ra ti shod/ zon zon mā sa thun rbad/ ces pas yungs kar gyi zor dgra phyogs su 'phangs pas/ yungs kar rdog po rnams pho nya yang sprul du bsams te/ skad cig gis song nas dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rdul du bun bun song nas ming yangamed par bsam zhing brgya rtsa brgyad du 'phang ngo*/ /de nas chu zor/ khrag zor/ mda' zor/ rdo zor/ mtshon zor rnams rim pas brgya rtsa re dgra phyogs su 'phang zhing*/ zor rnams las kyi sha za 'phro bas dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa la babs te khrag tu skyugs nas bsad/ mtshon gyis gtug /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ khyi kha le nag mo sod/ srog tri sod/ snying kha kha baṃ ya ya sod/ tsa ba ba ri mu sod/ gha ya sod/ ṇi ya sod/ rak+mo tsi t+ta rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ rak+mo nre sha ku ru lu thuṃ rbad/ rak+mo kha la tsa thun bh+yo/ rak+ta thun rbad/ tsa la tsa la bh+yo/ tsit+na la rbad/ snying la dun/ rak+mo kha la tsa tsa dun bh+yo/ ti tha baṃ ril/ sa ma ya dun bh+yo/ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya thun bh+yo/ zhes bzlas shing rnga dang rol mo bya/ zor 'phang*/ ngul mo dang dmod bcol byas pas zla ba mi bgrang bar dgra la yams nad dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ ltas ngan dang*/ ye 'drog byung nas phung bar byed do/ /'di shin tu gnyan pas lta dgongs brtan pa gal che'o/
